scenarios.title: Generator to Lamp
scenarios.records: Generator: 150 J electrical and 50 J thermal. Lamp: 45 J light and 105 J thermal.
scenarios.predictionPrompt: Which output is useful for the stated mission?
predictions: All energy is useful for every purpose
scenarios.explanationPrompt: Explain the complete energy account and why the stated purpose determines useful output.
scenarios.keyIdea: Energy is conserved. Include useful and less-useful transfers; matter does not become energy.
hints: Identify the stated input and the output that meets the mission purpose.
The output amounts must total the input. Less-useful thermal and sound outputs still belong in the account.
scenarios.teacherReasoning: The generator gives 150 J electrical to the lamp and 50 J thermal. The lamp gives 45 J light and 105 J thermal; the whole account is 200 J.

scenarios.title: Food to Movement
scenarios.guardrail: Food is matter containing chemical potential energy; atoms do not become energy.
scenarios.records: Supplied muscle motion: 150 J. Complete the thermal account.
scenarios.predictionPrompt: Which output is useful for the stated mission?
predictions: All energy is useful for every purpose
scenarios.explanationPrompt: Explain the complete energy account and why the stated purpose determines useful output.
scenarios.keyIdea: Energy is conserved. Include useful and less-useful transfers; matter does not become energy.
hints: Identify the stated input and the output that meets the mission purpose.
The output amounts must total the input. Less-useful thermal and sound outputs still belong in the account.
scenarios.matterNote: Matter: food and oxygen are rearranged into carbon dioxide and water; chemical potential energy is transferred. Plants also respire.
scenarios.teacherReasoning: Food contains matter and chemical potential energy. Motion 150 J plus thermal 450 J accounts for 600 J; food atoms do not become energy.

scenarios.title: Plant Energy Storage
scenarios.guardrail: Illustrative energy values; matter inputs and products are represented separately.
scenarios.records: Supplied stored chemical energy: 320 J. Complete the thermal account.
scenarios.predictionPrompt: Which output is useful for the stated mission?
predictions: All energy is useful for every purpose
scenarios.explanationPrompt: Account for the supplied 400 J of light input, keep matter separate from energy transfers, and explain why the plant also needs cellular respiration.
scenarios.keyIdea: Energy is conserved. Include useful and less-useful transfers; matter does not become energy.
scenarios.matterNote: Matter: carbon dioxide and water form carbohydrate and oxygen. Light energy is stored as chemical potential energy. These values are illustrative, not measured photosynthetic efficiency. Plants also respire, transferring stored chemical potential energy for cellular functions.
scenarios.teacherReasoning: The illustrative 400 J light input gives 320 J stored chemical and 80 J thermal. Matter inputs and products remain separate. Plants also respire to transfer stored chemical energy for cellular functions.

scenarios.title: Motor Account
scenarios.records: Electrical input: 1200 J. Useful motion: 450 J. Calculate the other output and useful percentage.
scenarios.predictionPrompt: Which output is useful for the stated mission?
predictions: All energy is useful for every purpose
scenarios.explanationPrompt: Explain the complete energy account and why the stated purpose determines useful output.
scenarios.keyIdea: Energy is conserved. Include useful and less-useful transfers; matter does not become energy.
hints: Identify the stated input and the output that meets the mission purpose.
The output amounts must total the input. Less-useful thermal and sound outputs still belong in the account.
scenarios.teacherReasoning: 1200 J input − 450 J useful motion = 750 J thermal. Useful fraction is 450/1200 = 37.5%; the complete account is conserved.
